title: Luxury Hospitality Operations Manager
description: Supervise luxury hotel operations, guest experience excellence, F&B services, and revenue management across premium resort properties.
details:
### Role Overview
Leading luxury hospitality brand looking for an Operations Manager to champion guest relations, resort experience, and food & beverage management.

### Key Responsibilities
- Maintain 5-star service delivery across hotel departments, front desk, housekeeping, and culinary teams.
- Analyze guest satisfaction metrics, occupancy rates, and average daily rates (ADR) to maximize revenue.
- Oversee VIP guest protocols, corporate banquet events, and hospitality staff training.

### Requirements
- Bachelor’s Degree in Hotel Management or Hospitality Administration.
- 5+ years of operational experience in 5-star hotels or premium resort properties.
